name: Early-high, late-unconditional guidance (megapack)
plain: Full guidance at the sampler's cfg for the first part of the run, then, from the switch point (ComfyUI percent, by noise level), the chain runs at a fixed late scale. The default late scale of 0 returns the unconditional prediction alone; 1 would return the conditional. Because it uses the 'fixed scale' outside mode, any other megapack stages keep acting after the switch, and the unconditional pass is never skipped.
math:
σ_sw = percent_to_sigma(switch).
σ ≥ σ_sw: x̂ = chain(w) (plain mix: x̂_u + w(x̂_c − x̂_u)).
σ < σ_sw: x̂ = chain(w_late); w_late = 0 gives x̂ = x̂_u, w_late = 1 gives x̂ = x̂_c.
